necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurologic deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks, occurring in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Given the personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to embolic risk. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
